limitations: Sharp universal temporal-order threshold only for the stated switched negative-feedback DDE class inside the strict contraction regime, not an individual-history equivalence. Equality gives a flat interval in an explicit example. Some older full texts were inaccessible; historical priority remains provisional. Independent validation is absent.
scientific_integrity: The all-depth sharpness is proved by explicit histories. Finite rational checks corroborate, but do not establish, the universal theorem. The sufficient half and global invisibility use Theorems 5.1 and 1.1 of the cited source, whose key hypotheses and estimates were checked.
title: Sharp universal temporal-order boundary for finite nested state-dependent delays
